_meta.purpose: Each entry names one load-bearing guard and the verify that must go red when it is removed. This is the executable form of #122 shape D: an assertion that runs but cannot fail is indistinguishable from one that works.
_meta.why_not_every_guard: A guard whose removal is caught by three other checks adds a slow run and no signal. These are the ones where a silent failure would let a false claim through: identity binding, evidence readback, publication cadence, and the classification gates.
_meta.verify_must_be_self_contained: A verify command runs inside an isolated copy that carries no .git. A command needing repository history reports as unreachable, which is a true statement about the isolated run and a useless one about the guard, so entries point at the self-contained subset instead.
